headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: A Panama-flagged tanker, the On Peace, was hit by an unknown projectile in Hormuz, wounding 12 crew; no one claimed it. Qatar says US–Iran messages are still moving through Doha. Trump says the US must finish with Iran "the nice way or the not-so-nice way." Houthis claimed strikes on Riyadh's airport and the Rabigh refinery; the East-West line is moving oil to Yanbu. Brent dipped below $100.
change_note: Oct. 7: Escalated war now means a step the war hasn't taken yet: ground forces in Iran, strikes on Iranian civilian infrastructure, or a major Gulf export hub, power or desalination plant knocked out for a week. Another July-style strike campaign counts as limited war. Escalated by Nov. 3: 14% → 7%; by year-end: 20% → 12%. War by Nov. 3 holds at 60%.

bets.cond: The IRGC officially claims a confirmed hit, lays mines or strikes infrastructure
bets.effect: War by Nov. 3 resolves yes; escalated ~10%

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
The East-West line or Yanbu is offline 3+ days
